body:
Source: the ADLC principle-fidelity audit (delta.md, PR #486). This ticket remediates one of the eight root-cause "seams" that audit found — cases where the toolkit trusts the model at the boundary between a built gate and the deployed system.

SEAM 8 (medium). Post 6's thesis is "run N+1 cheaper than run N", but it is unmeasured: the findings ledger records ZERO spend, the calibration recall number never reaches the manifest or the prosecution verdicts, and there is no scheduled skill-rot/model-ratchet cron (only copilot-live-canary, ceremony-drift, pi-version-matrix run on a schedule). The ratchet is designed but not turning; the central economic claim is not observable.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR
1. Wire real spend capture into the findings ledger / manifest so cost-per-merged-verified-change is computable run-over-run (respect the existing no-fabrication rule: unmeasured is "unreported", never zero).
2. Carry the review-calibration recall number into the gate-manifest so prosecution verdicts are self-describing (recall alongside test hashes and rails proofs).
3. Add scheduled workflows for skill-rot and model-ratchet (docs/ci/adlc-maintenance.yml pattern) so cache-invalidation and frontier re-prosecution actually fire.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Spend is captured into the manifest/ledger and is non-zero for a run that reports usage (still "unreported" when absent, never fabricated zero). verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/spend-capture.test.mjs`
- The calibration recall number is recorded into the gate-manifest. verify: `node --test packages/gate-manifest/test/recall-record.test.mjs`
- Scheduled skill-rot and model-ratchet workflows exist. verify: `node -e "const fs=require('fs');const y=fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/adlc-maintenance.yml','utf8');process.exit(/skill-rot/.test(y)&&/model-ratchet/.test(y)?0:1)"`

allow-suppression: none
title: Make the cost ratchet observable: real spend capture, recall into manifest, skill-rot/model-ratchet cron
